coordinate_frame.origin: bar-top surface at the centre of Jumper's start slot
coordinate_frame.customer_side: -Y (camera point of view; no 3D human), looking +Y

bar.collision: the accepted coffee_bar counter slab (1.20 x 0.80 x 0.04 m, contact parameters and all) moved with the brew station and declared the package ground (rebuilt as the task's `terrain` geom), plus three coplanar static extensions bar_top_ext_left/right/back out to the bar edges; all invisible
bar.visual: one wooden box over the whole bar, its top 0.3 mm below the collision surface
bar.why_the_accepted_slab: measured: the M4 replay under the same robot on a 2.20 x 0.95 x 0.05 m bar box moved the carried grasp by 1.3 mm (10.71 mm vs the 10 mm gate; 9.45 mm accepted), while the accepted slab moved by the same offset reproduced 9.45 mm

brew_station.copy: rigid translation of the accepted package's server, V60 and pitcher bodies (and its hero/overhead cameras), loaded through the hash-checked package reader; the accepted counter slab, back lip, lights and standing-slot marker are dropped because the bar replaces them
brew_station.compiled_offset_note: the accepted package is attached with its standing-slot site (z = 0.002 m) at the origin, so its compiled counter sits at z = -0.002 m; the cafe package spawns from its authored origin, so compiled cafe = compiled coffee_bar + compiled_offset_m

added_brewer_geometry.v60_coffee_bed: static collidable 32 mm radius, 4 mm thick disc whose top is 1.5 mm below the accepted coffee_bed_target plane; coffee grounds are physical, and as brewer geometry it is inside every M4 collision and stream gate

kettle.simulation_behavior: static; body collidable, gooseneck spout, lid and handle visual

pour_start_pose.derivation: accepted M4 base_start (-0.018725, 0.095488, 0.10647, yaw 0) in the compiled coffee_bar world plus compiled_offset_m

dance_area.justification: largest measured XY footprint radius (all collision geometry, about the start-slot centre) of the existing policies replayed in cafe_bar by footprints.py: dance_brazilian 0.327 m (full 66 s), jump 0.319 m (flat jump in place), dance_maze 0.318 m, dance_crab 0.318 m over its first 60 s, dance_waist 0.290 m, dance_dream_wings 0.281 m; rounded up to 0.34 m
dance_area.out_of_scope: dance_crab's full 236 s routine walks the base 0.40 m and reaches 0.58 m, which no bar this deep can hold; the film's idle beat must use at most its first 60 s (or another dance)

door.simulation_behavior: visual only, off-camera for the customer POV

customer_camera.note: adjust eye_height_above_bar_m and position_m freely; nothing physical depends on it
